questions.question: Which African country is completely landlocked by South Africa?
questions.fun_fact: Lesotho is one of only three independent nations in the world completely surrounded by a single host country.

questions.question: What is the chemical symbol for the element gold?
questions.fun_fact: The symbol 'Au' comes from the Latin word 'aurum', meaning 'shining dawn'.

questions.question: Which 1994 film features the famous line, 'Life is like a box of chocolates'?
questions.fun_fact: Tom Hanks famously improvised a slight variation of this line, which originally appeared in the novel by Winston Groom.

questions.question: The ancient city of Carthage was located near the modern-day coast of which country?
questions.fun_fact: Carthage was founded by the Phoenicians in the 9th century BCE and later became the rival of the Roman Republic.

questions.question: What is a group of crows commonly called?
questions.fun_fact: Crows are exceptionally intelligent birds that can recognize individual human faces and remember them for years.

questions.question: Traditional pesto sauce originates from which region of Italy?
questions.fun_fact: Pesto alla Genovese specifically hails from Genoa, the capital city of the Liguria region.

questions.question: In bowling, what term is used when a player knocks down all ten pins with two consecutive rolls in a single frame?
questions.fun_fact: While a strike is scored with the first ball of a frame, a spare requires two rolls to clear the deck.

questions.question: From which language did English borrow the word 'safari'?
questions.fun_fact: The Swahili word 'safari' ultimately derives from an Arabic root meaning 'to make a journey'.

questions.question: Which planet in our solar system has the most prominent and complex ring system visible from Earth?
questions.fun_fact: Saturn's rings are made almost entirely of chunks of water ice, ranging in size from microscopic dust to boulders.

questions.question: Which Byzantine emperor commissioned the construction of the Hagia Sophia in Constantinople during the 6th century?
questions.fun_fact: Upon its completion in 537 CE, Emperor Justinian reportedly exclaimed, 'Solomon, I have surpassed thee!'
